Option Explicit

Private heldObject As Item
Private Function GetTarget(ByVal mode As Long) As Variant
    Trace = Trace & "O"

        GetTarget = 42
    ElseIf mode = 2 Then
        Set GetTarget = Nothing
    Else
        Set GetTarget = heldObject
    End If
End Function
Private Function GetMemberName(ByVal value As Variant) As Variant
    Trace = Trace & "N"
    GetMemberName = value
End Function

    Trace = Trace & "K"

End Function

    Trace = Trace & "R"
